definition.en: An infection or inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs and tissues of the lungs.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: An infection or inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs and tissues of the lungs.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: An infection or inflammatory condition affecting the air sacs and tissues of the lungs.

explanation.en: Pneumonia can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or other organisms and may lead to cough, fever, breathing difficulty, and chest discomfort.

definition.en: A chronic inflammatory airway disorder characterized by variable airflow limitation and bronchial hyper-responsiveness.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A chronic inflammatory airway disorder characterized by variable airflow limitation and bronchial hyper-responsiveness.
definition.fa: خلاصه آموزشی: A chronic inflammatory airway disorder characterized by variable airflow limitation and bronchial hyper-responsiveness.

explanation.en: Asthma commonly causes episodes of wheezing, cough, chest tightness, and shortness of breath; triggers and severity vary between people.
